The filmmaker explores the wilderness of Tanzania and sheds light on the different types of wildlife living in the region.
The filmmaker delves into the fascinating life of five young lions residing in the Masai Mara reserve in Kenya while highlighting the threats they face such as poaching and habitat loss.
The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls.
The filmmaker puts a spotlight on wild animals that possess extraordinary abilities and have mastered the art of survival over the course of their evolution.
